origin.pooltoy.pooltoy.name: Pooltoy
origin.pooltoy.pooltoy.description: A squeaky, air-filled inflatable come to life. Pooltoys bounce off the ground, bob on the water and drift through the air, but one sharp point or open flame is all it takes to spring a leak.
power.pooltoy.bouncy.name: Bouncy
power.pooltoy.bouncy.description: Your inflatable body absorbs every landing. You take no fall damage.
power.pooltoy.buoyant.name: Buoyant
power.pooltoy.buoyant.description: You float up to the surface of water and move 50% faster through it. Sneak to dive underwater, or sprint-swim to stay down.
power.pooltoy.floaty_jump.name: Floaty Jump
power.pooltoy.floaty_jump.description: You jump higher and drift slowly back down. Sneak to fall at normal speed.
power.pooltoy.air_reserve.name: Air Reserve
power.pooltoy.air_reserve.description: You are full of air, so you can stay underwater twice as long before running out of breath.
power.pooltoy.weakness_sharp.name: Puncturable
power.pooltoy.weakness_sharp.description: Sharp things are your worst enemy. You take 50% more damage from arrows, tridents, swords, axes, thorns, cactus, berry bushes, bee stings and dripstone.
power.pooltoy.weakness_fire.name: Meltable
power.pooltoy.weakness_fire.description: Your vinyl skin melts easily. You take double damage from fire, lava, magma blocks and fireballs.
power.pooltoy.weakness_knockback.name: Lightweight
power.pooltoy.weakness_knockback.descrip: You weigh almost nothing. Hits send you flying farther, and knockback resistance (such as Netherite armor) does nothing for you.
